info.title: Saturation API
info.description:
Read and write production finance data in Saturation. Authenticate with a personal token in the `Authorization` header: `Bearer <token>`. Create a token under Settings > Developers > API. Each token belongs to one workspace.
Conventions:
- Successful responses contain the requested resource. Lists contain `data` and an optional `nextCursor`. Errors contain `success`, `code`, `message`, and `requestId`.
- Money uses integer minor units and an ISO-4217 currency, for example `{ "amount": 152900, "currency": "USD" }`. Dates use ISO 8601.
- Lists default to 50 items and allow up to 100. Pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page. Set `withCount=true` to include the total count.
- `404 not_found` means the resource does not exist or is not available to the token.

post.summary: Send feedback about the API, MCP server, or CLI
post.description: Records what worked or broke and posts it to the Saturation team. Not a support channel; nobody replies. Text is scrubbed of emails, amounts, long numbers, and non-Saturation URLs before it is stored. Limited to 20 items per credential owner in any 24 hours; over the limit returns `429 feedback_limit`, which must not be retried. Agents: show the draft to the user and send only after they approve.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique request key, 16 to 255 characters. Retrying the same request returns the first response. Missing or invalid keys return `400 validation`; reuse with a different body returns `409 idempotency_conflict`.

example.message: transactions list ignores --project when --format csv is set
example.context: Exporting one project's transactions for a cost report

429.description: `feedback_limit`: this credential owner sent 20 items in the last 24 hours. Not sent; do not retry, and no `Retry-After` is sent. `rate_limited`: the general request limit; wait for `Retry-After`.

Retry-After.description: Present only on `rate_limited`. Seconds to wait before retrying.
